features.name: log_f5_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed f5 normalized to approximate unit scale, smoothing the wide range for linear margin computation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear SVM benefits from smooth bounded transformations of skewed inputs.

features.name: f6_excess_over_baseline
features.description: Excess of f6 above its observed minimum baseline (77), capturing severity above floor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized continuous score useful for SVM hyperplane separation.

features.name: f7_f8_ratio
features.description: Ratio of f7 to f8, capturing relative magnitude between two correlated baseline-like features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratios reveal proportional structure that linear models capture directly.

features.name: f9_deviation_from_floor
features.description: Deviation of f9 from its near-constant floor of 94, normalized by observed range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures rare elevations in a tight-distribution feature for SVM margin.

features.name: early_block_sum
features.description: Sum of features f13-f18 representing early-block aggregate activity, log-scaled for smoothness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear composite aggregates correlated columns producing a strong SVM projection axis.

features.name: mid_block_sum
features.description: Sum of features f19-f24 representing mid-block aggregate activity, log-scaled.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth aggregate of mid-range columns suitable for linear margin.

features.name: tail_block_sum
features.description: Sum of features f25-f33 representing tail-block sparse activity, log-scaled.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates very sparse columns into a meaningful continuous signal.

features.name: early_to_tail_ratio
features.description: Ratio of early-block activity to tail-block activity capturing distribution shift across columns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes structural shape useful for linear discrimination.

features.name: active_column_count
features.description: Count of nonzero entries among the variable activity columns f13-f33.
features.expected_model_benefit: Sparsity counts are a linear signal often correlated with row complexity.

features.name: peak_activity_magnitude
features.description: Maximum value across the variable activity columns f13-f33, log-scaled.
features.expected_model_benefit: Peak magnitude provides a smooth severity index for linear SVM.

features.name: header_block_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of header-like features f5-f9 producing a smooth approximate linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates a useful linear axis blending top variable features.

features.name: row_activity_profile_quality
features.description: Semantic assessment of how 'concentrated' versus 'diffuse' the activity profile across f13-f33 appears: low values indicate diffuse spread, high values indicate concentration in a few columns. Computed as ratio of peak magnitude squared to sum of squares of all activity columns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized concentration index that linear SVM can use as a discriminating dimension.
